visual_review: All 35 pages inspected through full-resolution contact sheets; equation-dense pages and final appendix inspected individually. No clipping, collisions, missing maths, or isolated near-empty body page remained.
observational_scope: Fresh selected data-cell extraction and whole-galaxy bootstrap; exact cells in report Appendix A. Full notebooks and plotting galleries not rerun. Large individual FITS maps not all fingerprinted.
fit_scope: Seven stellar-density bins; constant profile attenuation; 10000 whole-galaxy draws, complete-vector conditioning, linear-density and leave-one-galaxy sensitivity.
scientific_limits: Pre-peak field equivalence is an explicit working assumption.
Infall stages are not a calibrated clock.
Intensity attenuation is the fitted component; gas-loss rates and ionizing sources are not uniquely inferred.
The illustrative forward realization fails some NSF-contribution and inner-intensity amplitudes.
NGC4654 is a potential localized signal; no calibrated PA or gradient significance was computed.

delegation.role: Bounded primary-source retrieval and read-only citation review
delegation.main_agent_owned: Scientific model, data masks, units, derivations, fitting, uncertainty and acceptance
